- Color varies from purple to brown to dark brown
- Irregular, blotchy patches (not small spots, not elongated streaks)
- Plant otherwise appears healthy and upright

- **Purple_Leaf_Sheath** (view 8, Corn_Disease_6.jpg): Also shows purple/brown discoloration on sheath, consistent with the disease.
- All other candidates (Anthracnose, Physoderma_Brown_Spot, Physoderma_Stalk_Rot, Diplodia_Stalk_Rot, Charcoal_Stalk_Rot, Bacterial_Stalk_Rot) showed distinctly different visual patterns.
